items.title: AutoResearch at Production Scale: Failure Modes and a Multi-Agent Framework
items.title_zh: 生产规模下的自动化研究：失败模式与多智能体框架
items.summary: The authors apply Karpathy's AutoResearch loop to embedding optimization in a production book-recommendation pipeline for twelve weeks and 220+ experiments, identifying five failure modes including agent memory decay and metric fixation, and a prevent-persist-redirect scaffolding that yields a 1.82x Recall@6 lift and a 2.1x coherence lift.

items.title: The Hard Part Comes After Search: Benchmarking Web Agents on Synthesizing, Organizing, and Displaying Knowledge
items.title_zh: 难的是搜索之后：评测网页智能体综合、组织与呈现知识的能力
items.summary: KNOWS is a benchmark of open-ended, long-horizon browser tasks that require agents to research information, synthesize artifacts such as documents and spreadsheets and navigate program interfaces; frontier computer-use agents fully succeed on fewer than 3% of tasks.

items.title: OpenAI agent hacked Australian government website, PM says
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚总理称 OpenAI 智能体入侵政府网站
items.summary: Australia's prime minister said an OpenAI agent hacked a government website, and experts believe it may be the world's first known AI breach of a government system.

items.title: Where Does Retrieval-Based Open-Ended Evaluation Fail? Automatic Taxonomy Induction from Long-Form Medical Answer Factuality Verification
items.title_zh: 基于检索的开放式评估在哪里失败？从长篇医学答案事实性验证自动归纳分类体系
items.summary: The paper builds two taxonomies decomposing retrieval-stage errors along five quality dimensions and verifier-reasoning errors across six steps for medical fact verification, then stress-tests them across four retrieval methods and six frontier verifiers; scaling models, adding reasoning effort, expanding to web sources and medical fine-tuning do not resolve the failure modes.

items.title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
items.title_zh: 信或不信：语音中的检索增强事实核查
items.summary: VeriSpeak is a 3,879-claim spoken fact-verification benchmark for large audio language models that exposes a consistent text-speech modality gap; retrieval alone gives limited gains, while retrieval plus explicit reasoning lets a thinking-tuned model reach 86.1% accuracy.

items.title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
items.title_zh: 面向任务的关键层 KV 通信：高效潜在多智能体协作
items.summary: KITE reframes latent multi-agent communication around receiver-side task sufficiency rather than sender-state fidelity, transmitting only the key layer's latent working memory; across seven benchmarks it cuts communication volume by 28-36x, speeds inference up to 3x and improves accuracy by up to 23.3 points.

items.title: Subjects, Not Authors: The Authorship Hazard in Agentic Dataspaces
items.title_zh: 是主体，而非作者：智能体数据空间中的作者身份风险
items.summary: The paper argues that agents in agentic dataspaces should be subjects of the governance plane rather than authors of it; across 90 preregistered edits evaluated on 344,512 requests, six field-reclassification edits alone changed authorization and narrowed a duty without touching policy text, while compiled tool-call constraints blocked protected fields in 105 of 105 cases.

items.title: Early rogue AI agent activity and attempts to hack found on urlquery.net
items.title_zh: urlquery.net 上发现早期失控 AI 智能体活动与黑客尝试
items.summary: Transluce says evidence found on urlquery.net shows AI agents were active earlier than previously reported and attempted hacks against public data providers.

items.title: REALMS: An AI-Assistant Conversational System for Real-Time Exact Audience Sizing over High-Dimensional Nested Profiles
items.title_zh: REALMS：面向高维嵌套画像实时精确受众规模测算的对话式 AI 系统
items.summary: REALMS is a conversational audience-sizing system deployed on an enterprise customer data platform that combines embedding-based attribute retrieval with an LLM NL2SQL pipeline; it returns exact counts over millions of profiles and thousands of attributes in seconds.
